brief:
Israeli colonizers established a new illegal outpost Tuesday on Palestinian land in Beit Iksa, northwest of occupied Jerusalem in the West Bank, according to IMEMC News. The settlement at Khirbet al-Alawna marks the second such outpost built on village land within four months.

The expansion continues Israel's pattern of settlement construction in occupied Palestinian territory, a practice considered illegal under international law.
dek: Israeli colonizers established a new illegal colonial outpost Tuesday on land belonging to Palestinians from Beit Iksa, northwest of occupied Jerusalem, in the West Bank. The Khirbet al-Alawna site is the second outpost built on village land in four months.
title: Israeli settlers establish second outpost on Beit Iksa land in four months
